title: Chow Vanishing and Motives of Cluster Varieties
summary: We prove that the integral Chow groups $CH_i$ and mixed Hodge degree $H^{2i, (i, i)}$ cohomology groups of a really full rank (RFR) sink-recurrent cluster variety vanish for $i > 0$. In particular this applies to braid varieties and open projected Richardson varieties in any Lie type.
